$schema_note: Brand pack for digitalplay.work. Machine-readable; the system prompt in digitalplay-brand-system-prompt.md is generated from the same decisions.

brand.name: digitalplay.work
brand.oneLiner: Free, open, playful creative tools you push about with your own stuff.
brand.mission: Give everyone free creative tools that are fun within a minute, teach the idea underneath, and can be taken apart and remade.
brand.origin: Named after the book Digital Play (Kyle Mawer and Graham Stanley, 2011) and Simon Nicholson's theory of loose parts (1971). Extends the book's idea from language learning to the creative arts.
audience: curious adults who want a break from scrolling
artists, musicians and coders who like tinkering

values.line: Fun within a minute. The clever bit comes second.
Every tool starts with the player's own material.
No accounts, adverts, paywalls or tracking.
MIT code, CC BY 4.0 content, single-file tools anyone can fork.
Tools work without a connection and send nothing anywhere.
Ideas and techniques, never imitations of named living people.

voice.summary: Plain, warm, Northern English. Talks like a mate showing you something good at the kitchen table.
traits: explains, then gets out of the way
voice.spelling: UK English: colour, organise, programme (TV), program (software), licence (noun), license (verb).
doSay: Push it about until something turns up
Take it apart and make it yours
Put the phone down for fifteen minutes
voice.punctuation: Curly quotes and apostrophes on the site. Spaced middle dot (·) as a separator in labels. En dash for ranges only.

colour.approach: Warm paper ground, deep ink text, and a toy-box set of primaries used as shapes and accents. Every pair used for text passes WCAG 2.2 AA.

tokens.role: tertiary text and counts (AA on paper and card)
links, focus rings, Moving Image and Ideas
shapes and fills only, never text (Art, Games & Play)
highlights and buttons; ink text only on top (Music, Design)
Photography & Image, Nature & Science, list markers

rules: No gradients, especially purple ones. The only gradient-like effect is the flat highlighter band under one word in a headline.
Section colour appears as a top border, a hard shadow or a single shape, never as a full background behind text.

typography.licence: All fonts SIL Open Font Licence 1.1, self-hosted as Latin-subset WOFF2. No runtime requests to Google.

display.notes: 800 weight, tight tracking (-0.02em), upright only, never italic headings

body.notes: Designed for legibility; 17px base, 1.6 line height, 66ch measure

mono.use: labels, kickers, nav, counts, keyboard hints
mono.notes: Uppercase with 0.06 to 0.08em tracking at small sizes

typography.toolFonts: Starter tools use system font stacks only so they stay a single file and work offline.

logo.mark: Four loose parts on a 40 × 40 grid: a tomato circle, a cobalt square turned 14°, a sun triangle with an ink outline, a moss arch.
logo.wordmark: 'digitalplay' in Bricolage Grotesque 800, lowercase, followed by '.work' in JetBrains Mono 400 in ink-2.
logo.clearSpace: Half the mark's height on every side.
dont: add a drop shadow or gradient
put it on a busy photo

principles: Asymmetric grids (7/4, 6/5, 5/4/5). Avoid three equal columns of icons.
Hero is content-height, never a full-viewport centred block.
Hard offset shadows (4 to 8px, ink or tomato), 2px ink borders, square corners.
Slight rotation (about 1°) is allowed on one illustrative object per page.
Use minmax(0,1fr) in grids and overflow-x: clip on the page.
layout.spacing: Fluid: gap clamp(1rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem); page edge clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem); max width 78rem.
layout.motion: Short transforms only (120ms). Never 'transition: all'. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.button: Card or sun fill, 2px ink border, 4px hard ink shadow; lifts 2px on hover, presses in on click.
components.card: Card fill, 2px ink border, 8px top border in the section colour, mono kicker, display title, plain summary, small facet tags, 'Try it' and 'Source' links.
components.tile: Section tile with a small coloured loose-part chip on its top edge; live tiles get a hard shadow in the section colour, coming-soon tiles are dashed.
components.learnPanel: Every tool has a LEARN panel (key L) and a Presets panel (key P) with JSON export and import.

use: screenshots of real tools in use

compliance.artists: No living artist's name or likeness in product names, branding or AI prompts that imitate a named person. Influences only as short factual 'inspired by' lines.
compliance.copyright: No copyrighted quotes, lyrics, scores, images or fonts without a licence.
compliance.privacy: No personal data, cookies, analytics or tracking. Visitors' Gemini keys stay in their own browser.
compliance.secrets: Never commit API keys. Scan for AIza, ghp_, sk- and xox before every commit and deploy.
compliance.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast, keyboard access, visible focus, reduced motion, lang='en-GB'.

channels.publishing: Drafts in docs/launch-posts.md; Craig queues them in Buffer himself. Nothing auto-posts.
